LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaSpikeStaff.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid short spear
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaSpikeStaff.description: A handmade short spear treated using traditional weapon-poisoning techniques, its broad head evenly infused with purple aphrodisiac nanofluid. Close thrusts deliver the fluid reliably, but can still cause fatal injuries.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaBlowpipe.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid blowpipe
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaBlowpipe.description: A handmade blowpipe with dart tips infused with aphrodisiac nanofluid using traditional weapon-poisoning techniques. Suited to repeated application at close to medium range, but poor against armor and inaccurate at distance.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaLightCrossbow.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid light crossbow
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaLightCrossbow.description: A handmade light crossbow with bolt heads infused with aphrodisiac nanofluid using traditional weapon-poisoning techniques. Greater range, accuracy and armor penetration than a blowpipe, at the cost of slower loading and more trauma.
